purpose: Accelerated F6_FADE_V1 profitability validation + holdout audit
exposure_audit_conclusion: Calendar year 2024 is EXPOSED_DATA_ONLY at worst (no strategy outcome of any kind ever computed against it in this repo's tracked history); this is the defensible unseen window. Everything from 2025-01-24 onward is OUTCOME_CONTAMINATED by ORPB_V1/FPRC_V1/production-strategy research; F6's own development window (2026-05-15..2026-08-14) is F6-specifically contaminated by construction.

validation_result.caveat: Narrow pass: session_coverage exactly at the 10-day minimum floor, bootstrap CI lower bound close to (though inside) the pre-registered zero-adjacent floor.

replication_result.note: Broader sample than validation; gross direction reversed; bootstrap CI entirely negative; not concentrated; no integrity issue.

development_reproduced.note: Reproduced via the same frozen evaluator for comparability; matches the task's own stated development warning sign (net at 10bps slightly negative) almost exactly.

final_classification_reasoning: Two of three independent periods (development, replication) show a net-negative, cost-adjusted result. Replication -- the larger, more statistically powerful of the two holdout tests -- decisively contradicts the hypothesis with a bootstrap CI entirely on the negative side, on a broad (not concentrated), integrity-clean sample. The one positive result (validation) is the thinnest of the three and sits at the pre-registered minimum sample-size floor. The long/short profitable side flips across all three periods (short-favored in development, long-favored in validation, neither in replication), which is itself evidence against a stable structural effect. Per the task's own non-negotiable rule, this is treated as a rejection, not explained away or rescued.
production_gap: F6_FADE_V1 has no stop_rule (frozen as NONE). Independent of today's rejection, any future fade-family candidate intended for production would need a defensibly-derived stop/risk rule (bias+entry+stop+exit/horizon), developed and frozen using DEVELOPMENT data only, never derived from validation/replication outcomes.
